description: Screen a new counterparty (person or company) in one call before onboarding, contracting or paying it. Checks sanctions (OFAC, EU, UK; UN via EU/UK), the US Consolidated Screening List, PEP (Wikidata) and registries (GLEIF, Norway). Returns no_match, possible_match, confirmed_match or unable_to_determine with confidence, sources, coverage_limitations and a screening_signal (not a compliance approval). Use for a first-pass screen before human review. $0.10 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: counterparty_due_diligence
